text:
devrel-anna: Noticed a strange failure in the embeddings->rerank pipeline during onboarding tests. Node + Go SDKs OK, but Python sample-app started failing sporadically with shape errors. Repro attached.

max.sdk: Thanks, can you paste the failing assertion?

devrel-anna: Assertion is in sample-app unit test that compares JSON responses across SDKs. Fails when embedding arrays are wrapped like [[0.2,0.1,...]] instead of [0.2,0.1,...].

piper: We got a customer report earlier that scoring functions returned a list-of-lists for single-candidate inputs and flat lists for multiple candidates. Sounds related.

qa-frank: I ran a timed e2e and forced token expiry mid-batch. Repro steps:
```
1) prepare 3 items
2) call embeddings.rerank with batch_size=3
3) set auth token TTL to 1s so it expires during request
```
Result: first call returned normal arrays, retry returned extra nesting and changed type (list vs typed array).

max.sdk: I traced this to the retry middleware. On 401 we re-run the client and then merge the partial response; our merge code used Array.concat semantics and accidentally inserted an extra array layer when the server returned a single candidate per result.

piper: Example traces: 
```
// initial response
{"results":[{"score":0.7,"embedding":[0.1,0.2]}]}
// after retry/merge
{"results":[{"score":0.7,"embedding":[[0.1,0.2]]}]}
```
That extra nesting breaks downstream scorer which expects float array.

devrel-anna: Workaround I've added to sample-app tests: a small normalizer before assertions:
```
def flatten_once(e):
  if isinstance(e, list) and len(e)==1 and isinstance(e[0], list):
    return e[0]
  return e
```
Not ideal for users.

max.sdk: I'll open a fast patch to the client retry merge logic to preserve scalar arrays and not wrap singletons. Also ensuring we don't convert to TypedArray in the wire JSON (keep JSON arrays).

qa-frank: Also found that the Node SDK converts arrays to Float32Array after parsing, which made the JSON diff tests fail even when shapes were equivalent. Suggestion: test should compare numeric contents normalized to plain arrays, not raw types.

piper: Agreed. We should standardize API contract: JSON responses are arrays-of-numbers (no TypedArray serialized). SDKs can expose convenience types locally, but wire format must be predictable.

infra-bot: Staged deploy: client retry fix pushed to canary (deploy id: canary-314).

devrel-anna: Action items: max to PR retry fix, SDK owners to add normalizer helpers (optional), QA to add auth-expiry e2e to CI that asserts stable shapes, docs to add note in embeddings.rerank contract.

max.sdk: PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/r/sdk/pulls/321 - small change to merge strategy + unit.

qa-frank: Added e2e test ticket QA-887, will add to CI once max's patch is in canary.

devrel-anna: Thanks! Keeping an eye on customer impact, will update onboarding guide with a short debugging snippet. :eyes:
